query.text: 请帮我留意站台广播，听到与登车有关的注意事项时及时提醒我。
query.text_en: Please monitor platform announcements and alert me to any boarding precautions.

annotation.text_zh: 广播提醒注意站台与列车之间的间隙。
annotation.text_en: The announcement says to mind the gap between the platform and train.

annotation.text_zh: 广播再次提醒注意站台间隙。
annotation.text_en: The announcement again says to mind the platform gap.

annotation.text_zh: 广播又提醒注意站台间隙。
annotation.text_en: The announcement again reminds you to mind the gap.
